notes.title: Three new achievements and Playstation port
notes.content:
Hello all!

Yesterday we've added three new achievements to Wild Island Quest.

Namely:
A new dawn: Survive the night.
Herbicide: Find the herbicide.
Knowledge is power: Visit the library.

They were required for Playstation port of this game, which was released on July 19th, and I decided to add them to the Steam version too. The achievements itself are simple and self-explanatory, I hope that there won't be any problems with achieving.

Another thing to mention is that we've completely changed the game engine for 64-bit Windows version. It is now Unreal Engine 5. The change was required because it would be very hard to port the original game engine (INSTEAD engine) to Playstation.

Also we've changed the graphics a little bit and made proofreading of English text, check it out :)
Please leave a feedback: do you like the changed graphics better then original? And what about the corrected text? Is it more readable than the original text?

If you want to play the original version of the game, it is available as beta branch with the name classic, I've added new 3 achievements to the original version of the game too.

Best regards,
Anton & NLB project team.

notes.title: Palladium: Adventure in Greece is now in the Steam store.
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

Yesterday, we finally released the game we've been working on for the last two years. This is a great event for our small team.
Palladium is a first-person 3D quest where you play as an archaeologist who explores an ancient labyrinth. He will have to solve riddles based on myths of ancient Greece. He can do so alone or take one of two possible companions. Each companion has his unique way of solving riddles, so if you finish the game with one companion, you can play again with another.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137270/Palladium_Adventure_in_Greece/

To celebrate the release of the game, we decided to make a sale of all our previous games, making the highest discounts we had ever made. The sale will take place on Steam from the 7th to 13th of June 2021. Some of our games have Steam trading cards.

We sincerely hope you will enjoy our games, and especially Palladium: Adventure in Greece!
Please share your opinion about the game on its Steam page. We appreciate all the feedback we can get!

Yours faithfully,
NLB project team

notes.title: Version 1.13 is out!
notes.content:
Hello all!

Next update of Wild Island Quest focuses on game stability and improves the user experience:
1) Native library used for Steam achievements support was rewritten (some potentially dangerous situations which can result in game crash were avoided, logging was added).
2) Introductory text made more clear.
3) Default music volume in game set to 25%. Remember, you can increase volume from game settings!
4) Die roll animations were slightly improved: there were a bunch of empty frames in the beginning of each animation. It looked like game lags (but it is not, it were just empty frames :) ). Now it is fixed.
5) Bug with die rolls was fixed (if saved when the die is on screen and loaded this save afterwards, the rolls were not updated)
6) Updated to the latest version of the INSTEAD engine (2.3.0)

As always, game restart is highly recommended (if you experience the error message when the autosave loads, you should close the message and restart the game; invoke the in-game menu by pressing Esc)

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Version 1.12 is out!
notes.content:
Hello all!
Version 1.12 is out.
PLEASE RESTART YOUR CURRENT GAME, your previous saved games will not work too. We are sorry for this inconvenience.
This build improves game experience:
1) Added animated die rolls when needed. You can play fair and accept the current roll or cheat and reroll if you wish, it's up to you :)
2) Added checkpoint system that allows you to restore some points of the game, if you think that you made incorrect decision and want to try another solution.
PLEASE NOTE: you can save at any time as before! The checkpoints are only for your convenience.
3) Unused languages and options were removed from the game menu.
We hope you'll like these improvements :)

Best regards,
NLB project team.

notes.title: Do you know that...
notes.content:
Some interesting facts (may be updated if we recall something :) )

1) The "battle system" of this book is intentionally such forgiving to the player. It is done to mimick game-books where you can cheat if you wish. That's why you can be always lucky if you want to... Or you can play fair and use real-world d6 dice. The choice is yours! :)
2) If you think that you are pretty limited in your choices, try to take another companions/items with you and you'll see the difference for sure.
3) The background images for the same location can be different for different combinations of companions/items.
4) We have some other free games which you can play for free right now! Just visit http://nlbproject.com/games

notes.title: From now on offensive content will be immediately removed
notes.content:
Hello everybody!
Personally, I prefer not to delete any comments, even negative ones.
But this community hub is not only related to our company, but also for people who like our game.
Therefore, if you want to post something, please, at least don't be rude and offensive and, most important, BE CONSTRUCTIVE!
Threads with offensive content will be removed.
Thank you all and happy gaming!
